scripts.check:validators: bun run codegen:validators && git diff --exit-code -- pipeline/dist/validate-*.mjs pipeline/dist/validate-*.d.mts
scripts.check:entity-fields: bun run codegen:entity-fields && git diff --exit-code -- pipeline/dist/entity-fields.mjs pipeline/dist/entity-fields.d.mts
scripts.bepinex:install: scripts/with-env.sh bash -c ': "${ARDENFALL_GAME_DIR:?set ARDENFALL_GAME_DIR}"; bun run scripts/install-bepinex.ts --game "$ARDENFALL_GAME_DIR"'
scripts.hotrepl:build: scripts/with-env.sh bash -c ': "${HOTREPL_REPO:?set HOTREPL_REPO}"; dotnet build "$HOTREPL_REPO/src/HotRepl.BepInEx" --nologo -v q'
scripts.hotrepl:deploy: scripts/with-env.sh bash -c ': "${HOTREPL_BEPINEX_OUT:?set HOTREPL_BEPINEX_OUT}"; : "${ARDENFALL_MOD_OUT:=./mod/bin/Debug/netstandard2.1}"; : "${ARDENFALL_PLUGINS_DIR:?set ARDENFALL_PLUGINS_DIR}"; bun run controller:deploy -- --hotrepl-out "$HOTREPL_BEPINEX_OUT" --mod-out "$ARDENFALL_MOD_OUT" --plugins "$ARDENFALL_PLUGINS_DIR" --bind-host "${HOTREPL_BIND_HOST:-127.0.0.1}" --port "${HOTREPL_PORT:-18590}"'
scripts.hotrepl:setup: bun run hotrepl:build && bun run mod:copy-libs && bun run mod:build && bun run hotrepl:deploy
scripts.hotrepl:export: scripts/with-env.sh bash -c ': "${HOTREPL_URL:?set HOTREPL_URL}"; : "${ARDENFALL_SNAPSHOT_OUT:=./snapshots}"; : "${ARDENFALL_PIPELINE_OUT:=./pipeline/dist}"; bun run controller:export -- --url "$HOTREPL_URL" --output "$ARDENFALL_SNAPSHOT_OUT" --pipeline-out "$ARDENFALL_PIPELINE_OUT"'
